system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Here is the problem statement and function:
system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are template strings with {{problem_statement}}, {{function}}, {{feedback}} variables; the exact line of the second quote was not verified. There are per-stage prompts in a fixed pipeline.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: These tools allow the LLM to search for class definitions and function definitions, or perform fuzzy string matching to locate and return relevant files.
env_context_strategy.note: Two mechanisms: the hierarchical localization injects PoC coverage, repo structure and context windows (--top_n, --context_window), and the LLM can also call search tools (patchpilot/util/search_tool.py).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Note that we still constrain the maximum length of the final root cause to make sure not to overwhelm the generation with excessive context.
context_compaction.note: Also --compress and --context_window in localization. Closest fit: the pipeline is stateless per stage rather than using a compacted conversation.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Accepts a string to search for and returns the file paths where the string is found.

tool_call_format.note: OpenAI-style function schemas are used for the search tools. Structured outputs are parsed from XML-like tags (e.g. <declaration>) in prompt.py. The exact line of the XML-tag usage was not verified.

tool_count.note: search_string, search_class_def, search_func_def, search_func_def_with_class_and_file. The localization code that registers them was not in the evidence, so the count covers what is defined here, not what is sent to the model.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: we also include a lightweight in-generation validation with lint and syntax checks, and reconduct this step if the check fails
edit_primitive.note: The edit format is not shown in the evidence; search_replace is the closest assumption and is low confidence. Consider not_reported. The quote documents step-wise patch generation, not the edit syntax.

protocol_standardization.note: Only 2 code files are available; there are no dependency contents to grep for mcp/a2a/acp.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: PatchPilot iteratively performs refinement and validation until it either identifies a qualified patch or reaches the maximum allowed number of generated patches (Nmax).
loop_primitives.note: Rule-based five-stage pipeline with batched candidates and a refinement loop (--refine_mod).

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The planning phase first queries the LLM to generate a patch plan with multiple steps.
planning_granularity.note: Plans are per-generation step lists. Whether a plan object is stored and re-read is not shown; this may qualify as explicit_plan_object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: PatchPilot is an innovative rule-based planning patching tool

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: rule-based planning that follows a fixed, predefined workflow for all issues

human_in_loop.note: The run-loop code (repair.py) is not in the bundle.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: most agent-based tools incur high costs because they need to maintain the LLM agent’s context history during localization
short_term_state.note: Pipeline passes stage outputs between stages via files (jsonl).

long_term_memory.note: No config surface is available to check for cross-run memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: If an experiment is interrupted, simply rerun the same command - PatchPilot will resume from where it left off.
state_persistence.note: Resume works at stage/instance granularity from output folders.

self_verification.evidence_quote: we first run our PoC on the patch candidates and use an LLM as a judge for its evaluation
self_verification.note: Lint/syntax checks come from Sec. 3.4. The formal CrossHair verification is from Sec. 5 (patchpilot/reproduce/formal_verification.py); whether it is on by default is unclear.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Number of samples generated per batch (early stopping if validation passes)
retry_policy.note: Capped by --max_samples (12 in the README example); the cap is secondary.

rollback.note: The repair code is not in the bundle.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: This process continues until a qualified patch that passes all validations is generated, or the total number of generated patches reaches the predefined limit ofNmax.

cost_controls.note: No model config code was available. --max_samples limits samples rather than tokens.

timeouts.note: Execution code is not in the bundle.
